title: Glowing crescent moon
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFBEA" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#FFE066" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFE066" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="moonGlow" cx="40%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF8D6"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FFE066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F5C400"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer soft glow -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="44" r="40" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- crescent moon body: big circle minus offset circle -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="44" r="28" fill="url(#moonGlow)"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="36" r="23" fill="#0A0A12"/>
  <!-- bright inner rim -->
  <path d="M 46 16 A 28 28 0 1 0 46 72 A 23 23 0 1 1 46 16 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FFFBEA" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- little star sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFFBEA">
    <polygon points="78,62 79.5,67 84,68.5 79.5,70 78,75 76.5,70 72,68.5 76.5,67" />
    <polygon points="24,74 25,77 28,78 25,79 24,82 23,79 20,78 23,77" />
    <polygon points="80,22 81,25 84,26 81,27 80,30 79,27 76,26 79,25" />
  </g>
</svg>
